decisions.reason: After only one year on the market and with no negative signal, this bread loaf is a low-cost extension of the core bakery range whose upside is still uncertain but worth keeping open in a growing market.
The guided historic mill tour fits the firm's heritage and event facilities, and with limited evidence so far it is sensible to preserve this experiential option until demand becomes clearer.
This sweet pastry is close to the established confectionery offer, likely inexpensive to continue, and there is not yet enough evidence after launch to justify abandoning it.
